description: This file defines a dialog component for creating or editing 'button' input elements within the CKEditor 4 rich text editor. It includes functions for getting and setting button properties, displaying the dialog, and handling user interactions to configure button attributes such as name, value, and type.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog
classes.description: Namespace for the dialog management system in CKEditor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser
classes.description: Namespace containing classes for parsing and manipulating HTML fragments.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.element
classes.description: Class representing DOM elements within CKEditor's virtual DOM.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new dialog definition with CKEditor.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model element representing the selected input element, if applicable.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Callback executed when the dialog is shown; sets up the dialog content based on current selection.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Callback for when the user clicks OK; commits the configured properties back to the editor.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Initializes dialog fields with data from the selected element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies dialog field values to the selected element.
